budget_note: 13 points: 1 over the standard-anatomy cap (12), inside major (25). Overage is toe-chain bones — same accounting finding as paw_hand_r (HANDS_FEET.md S7).

fit_qa.base: stub_shin — shin-end sleeve stub following the metatarsus path, ships in b11_hands_feet.blend
fit_qa.note: 100% burial is the correct signature of a sleeve seat (cf. the standard's tongue run: 73.7% buried = correct cavity seating). Residual excess is cuff verts seated deep along the sleeve axis. Cuff-region scoring is the applicable gate for extremity parts — see HANDS_FEET.md S6.
fit_qa.scored_region: hock/metatarsus cuff (main-mesh faces with all verts z >= 0.200), internal calcaneal-knob overlap verts excluded

gait.note: weight borne on digits II-V; digits III/IV primary (longest metapodials, central pair); metatarsal pad is a secondary contact under load

licence_tier: build — original procedural geometry authored for AnthroForge (no donor mesh); anatomy per WikiVet canine phalanges + library rig study cited in HANDS_FEET.md
